segments.en: Hello.
Hello, hello.
Can you hear me?
Can you hear me? Who is this?
My name is Arjun.
From Malappuram. You?
My name is Ashwathi. My place is Kollam. I am talking from Kollam.
How old are you?
I am 36.
Oh, are you married?
Yes, I am married.
What does your husband do?
My husband is a driver.
Do you have kids?
No. I had taken a test yesterday. Today he called and said everything is okay.
I don't know what this is. What is this? What do I get if I talk in this?
You will get payment. Per minute.
How will the payment come to my account?
It will be in coins. I don't know much about it.
Oh.
How is it?
Then?
Do you know the person from the other side?
Do you know anyone else from the other side?
No. If I turn this on, only then will the audio call work.
Then my husband... my husband is not here. My husband and I had a fight.
He is angry. He will be angry for two days. He won't come here.
Okay.
Is there an open talk option in this?
Yes, people ask for open talk in this.
What do you mean?
I mean, we can talk openly about everything.
Moosaettan said that if we call them, we just have to tell them.
It's not like that.
I don't know about that. Most of the people are like that. They ask for open talk.
If you are not interested, you can say you are not interested.
I cut the call. Earlier, some guy asked me about my height, weight, and asked me to show myself. So I cut the call and blocked him.
That's why I said there are some issues like that in this. Be careful when you talk.
Did you eat?
